planets.name: TOI-836 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-836 with a 8.6-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-836 c was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-836. Its orbit and size follow Hawthorn et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
